name: CPU-Based Block Decompression
definition: A decompression strategy where data blocks are decoded on the CPU before or during rendering, often using caching to reuse decompressed data for subsequent frames.
summary: CPU-Based Block Decompression decodes spatial data blocks on the CPU for high-quality reconstruction, differing from GPU-based methods by prioritizing CPU-side logic at the cost of increased CPU load and PCIe bandwidth usage.
